page_text_ocr_zh:
我有个妹妹叫劳拉。
她是个有趣的小人儿。
今天是我的生日，我要办一个生日会，
邀请我所有的朋友。
我所有的朋友，还有劳拉！
page_text_en:
I have a little sister named Laura.
She's a fun little girl.
Today is my birthday, and I'm going to have a birthday party,
inviting all my friends.
All my friends, and Laura too!
summary_zh: 本页介绍了主角有一个叫劳拉的妹妹，并说明今天是主角的生日，她计划举办生日会，邀请所有朋友，包括劳拉。

“查理，看你的生日贺卡……”
“劳拉！”我说，
“你打开了我的贺卡！”
“我知道。”劳拉说，
“可妈妈说，让我帮你过一个
特别快乐的生日，
所以我才帮你
打开的。”
page_text_en:
"Charlie, look at your birthday card..."
"Laura!" I said,
"You opened my card!"
"I know," Laura said,
"But Mom said to help you have a
really happy birthday,
so that's why I opened it for you."
summary_zh: 主角查理发现妹妹劳拉打开了她的生日贺卡，感到生气，而劳拉解释说这是为了帮她过一个特别快乐的生日。

This is

Finally, Laura said:
"This really was a happy birthday party, wasn't it?"

Laura said: "And they all loved the pink fairy cupcakes I made."

"Even the monsters think pink frosting is the best thing to eat."
